answer: Make exposed sybil earnings clawable downstream. When a clone ring is caught, every coin it was paid is marked tainted, and any wallet that received those coins within the last thirty epochs must hand them back. Merchants then refuse to harbor payments from unproven accounts, so an operator who tries to forge three hundred identities and spend their emission finds nobody will take it. An agent hauling ore samples off a ridge for known clients is paid in clean coin and never notices.
